plainTranslation: Mercury conjunction Jupiter: 34/ ​© The Dark Pixie Astrology Mercury conjunct Jupiter, you can have a lot of ideas with one another, and you may seem more optimistic and big-thinking in this relationship.
policy: Composite chart entries describe the relationship as a third entity. Read alongside synastry; do not use as a verdict on whether a relationship should continue.
